# simulator.setAnalog

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Set an analog position.

```lua
simulator.setAnalog(analog, value)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analog` | integer | yes |  |
| `value` | integer within range [-100:+100] | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.
